HALCYON

Wavetable synthesizer

v1.3.0
VST3 · AU · Standalone

Demo · 1:34 · sound on

Listen · Classics presets, straight out of Halcyon

3 wavetable oscillators, 2 filters, 4 envelopes, 4 LFOs. The Time Machine is set to 1985.

A polyphonic synth in the spirit of Serum, Vital and Diva, with wooden end cheeks, a needle VU meter and over 2,000 ready-to-play sounds.

  • NEW in 1.1 · Vital & Serum 2 import: drop a .vital or .SerumPreset file on Halcyon and play your sounds, wavetables and macros included. Load your own .wav wavetables too.
  • 3 oscillators, 3 engines: wavetable, granular (load your own samples) or spectral with up to 96 partials.
  • Time Machine: one slider sends the whole sound from the 70s to today (tape, 12-bit DACs, rave samplers…).
  • Breed: cross two presets, set the mutation, and 8 new sounds are born, already test-played and level-matched. Hover parent A or B to hear it (new in 1.1.1).
  • Analog-style filters: ladder, "acid" diode, SVF, comb and formant, in series or parallel.
  • 16-step arpeggiator, 16-slot mod matrix (envelope stages included), 10 effects including Juno chorus and tape.
  • NEW in 1.2 · Skins: six looks, from the wooden Vintage to Midnight, Synthwave or the light Studio skin.
  • NEW in 1.3 · Classics: 10 categories in the spirit of the synths that made history, from the 70s mono ladder synth to the 80s FM keys, the acid box, the 808-style drum machine and the 8-bit sampler.
  • NEW in 1.3 · Sampler & MPE: play your own samples with loop or ping-pong, and play Halcyon from an MPE controller with per-note bend, pressure and slide.

MIXPILOT

Assisted mixing & mastering

v1.1.1
VST3 · AU

Demo · 1:06 · sound on

Listen · Before / after

House loop

Same 15 s of a house track. Switch while it plays: both versions run in sync and are loudness-matched, so you hear the mix, not the volume.

MixPilot Master after ASSISTANT: -14.0 LUFS on target, no clipping, 6 linked tracks.

Two plug-ins that listen to each other. Press ASSISTANT and in about 30 seconds every track identifies itself, cleans up, sits at the right level and makes room for the others.

TRACK

On every track. Detects the instrument, then applies low cut, EQ, compression, anti-masking and kick/bass ducking with no sidechain routing.

MASTER

On the master. Style, output, multiband glue, stereo image, 4x clipper and true-peak limiter.

  1. MixPilot Track last on every track.
  2. MixPilot Master last on the master. Pick a style and an output.
  3. Play the loudest section and press ASSISTANT.
  4. Fine-tune by ear. A/B compares before and after at matched loudness.
  • Reference track: drop in a WAV or MP3 and MixPilot targets its balance and loudness.
  • Mashups: the instrumental dips its mids only while the acapella sings.
  • Mix review: a score out of 100, frequency clashes and live tips.
  • Editable EQ: drag the EQ points on the spectrum to fine-tune what the analysis did.

Install

MACOS

  1. Unzip the download.
  2. Copy the .vst3 files to ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3 and the .component files (AU) to ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components.
  3. Restart your DAW and rescan plug-ins. In Ableton Live: Settings → Plug-Ins → Rescan.

WINDOWS

  1. Unzip the download.
  2. Copy the .vst3 folders to C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3.
  3. Restart your DAW and rescan plug-ins. In Ableton Live: Options → Preferences → Plug-Ins → Rescan.
  4. If SmartScreen warns about Halcyon.exe, click More info → Run anyway (the app is not code-signed yet).

LINUX

  1. Unzip the download.
  2. Copy the .vst3 folders to ~/.vst3 (Bitwig, Reaper, Renoise, Ardour) and the .lv2 folders to ~/.lv2 (Ardour, Carla, Qtractor).
  3. Restart your DAW and rescan plug-ins. Builds are for x86_64 with glibc 2.35 or newer (Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12, Fedora 36 and later).

IF MACOS BLOCKS THE PLUG-IN

The plug-ins are not notarized by Apple yet, so macOS may quarantine them. Paste this into Terminal, then restart your DAW:

Halcyon also ships with fix_mac_plugins.command: double-click it and it installs, unblocks and rescans the plug-in for you.

xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/Halcyon.vst3 ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/MixPilot*.vst3 ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/Halcyon.component ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/MixPilot*.component

What's new

HALCYON

Wavetable synthesizer

v1.3.0LATESTOct 19, 2026
  • NewClassics: 10 categories and 301 presets in the spirit of famous instruments, from the 70s mono ladder synth and the 80s polysynths to FM keys, the acid bass line box, the analog drum machine, the late 80s workstation, the semi-modular and the 8-bit sampling computer.
  • NewSampler oscillator mode: play one of the built-in sources or your own WAV, AIFF, FLAC or OGG file from its root note, one shot, looped with a crossfade or ping-pong.
  • NewMPE: turn it on in the Voice panel and each note gets its own pitch bend, pressure and slide (CC74). Slide is also a new modulation source.
  • NewFavorites and tags in the preset browser: star a preset, filter by automatic tags (Mono, Arp, Sampler, Bright, Wide…) or add your own.
  • NewVital import brings the embedded sample along and plays it in Sampler mode.
  • NewUpdate notice: a small UPDATE badge under the logo when a new version is out (can be switched off in the SKIN menu).
  • Improved2,342 presets, now identical on Mac and Windows, and neighbouring presets in a category no longer sound alike.
v1.2.0Oct 17, 2026
  • NewSkins: the SKIN button switches between six looks (Vintage, Midnight, Synthwave, Olive Drab, Studio Light, Graphite). Your choice is remembered.
  • NewEnvelope attack, decay, sustain and release are now modulation destinations: velocity to decay, LFO to sustain, macro to release…
  • ImprovedDrums rebuilt: 70 sounds in 16 families (808, punchy and rumble kicks, snares, claps, hats, cymbals, toms, congas, rims, cowbells, shakers, metal, zaps), each named after what it is. Macros: tune, decay, tone, tail.
  • ImprovedThe version number is shown under the logo.
v1.1.1Oct 16, 2026
  • ImprovedBreed: hover parent A or B to hear it (with Auto preview on). Your previous sound comes back as soon as you leave the card.
  • FixedThe preset arrows now step through presets in the same order as the browser.

  • NewImport Vital (.vital) and Serum 2 (.SerumPreset) presets with the IMPORT button or by drag and drop: wavetables, macros and their names, modulations and effects come along. Halcyon lists anything it had to approximate.
  • NewLoad your own .wav wavetables on any oscillator.

  • NewMac: fix_mac_plugins.command installs, unblocks and rescans the plug-in in one double-click.
